result.title: Guinness World Records 2024: Most Titles in Women's World Badminton ...
result.content: A total of 32 elite men's and women's badminton teams from 20 countries and regions across the world will compete for the team world championships at the 2024 Thomas & Uber Cup Finals in Chengdu, Southwest China's Sichuan Province, from April 27 to May 5.

result.title: Guinness World Records 2024 Most Wins Women's World Badminton Team ...
result.content: There isn't a Guinness World Record listed for "most wins" by a women's team at the World Badminton Team Championships in 2024. The Uber Cup is the official women's world team championship, and China leads all- time with 16 titles, while India made history by winning the Badminton Asia Team Championships 2024 gold.

result.title: Guinness World Records 2024 Women's World Badminton Team Championships ...
result.content: China dominates women's badminton team events with 8 out of the last 10 BWF World Championships women's doubles titles, and India made history in 2024 by winning its first-ever Badminton Asia Team...

result.title: Guinness World Records 2024 Most Titles Women's World Badminton Team ...
result.content: China holds the most Uber Cup titles with 16 wins, making it the most successful country in the women's world badminton team championships as of 2024. India is the current Asian Women's Team champion, winning gold at the Badminton Asia Team Championships 2024.

The most wins at the World Team Badminton Championships (female) is 16, achieved by China in 1984, 1986, 1988, 1990, 1992, 1998, 2000, 2002, 2004, 2006, 2008, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2021 and 2024.
The Uber Cup or World Women's Team Championships was instituted in 1956. China won a record-extending 16th title on 5 May 2024, defeating Indonesia 3–0 in the final in Chengdu, China.
